notes.title: Blades of Mirage will be at Bandung Gaming Days!
notes.content:
Here are some event highlights:
Local Game Competitions Witness the excitement as talented players compete in two local games, Loka Pala and Battle of Guardians, in spirited tournaments.
Mobile Legends Tournament Local gamers will battle it out for the championship title and exciting prizes in this competition.
Cosplay Competition Show off your creativity by dressing up as your favorite game or anime character. Become the center of attention in this colorful and imaginative cosplay event.
Local Game Exhibition Discover the best works from six local game studios in Bandung, including:


 Pamali by Storytale
 DreadOut 2 by Digital Happiness
 The Blue Cut Hook by Plexus/Oray
 Nightmareside The Game by Hige Studio
 Grim Trial by Glory Jam
 Blades of Mirage by Agate


Don't miss out on the fun and excitement at Bandung Gaming Days 2025!
